attributes.residual: REGISTER_ONLY/address-materialization. The direct-global member spelling is the only form that flips the (base+idx)+K association MWCC otherwise canonicalizes to base+(idx+K) - proven positively by the already-exact sibling GetMilestonePos, whose `sItemRuntime.milestones[idx].matrix[12]` emits target's exact `mulli / lis+addi / add / lfs 15940(r3)`. But every conversion is paid for at 2 insns per region by symbol re-materialization, which exceeds the gain. Target achieves BOTH (one lis/addi into r29 at 0x3c-0x40, held whole-function, plus per-access add+displacement); no portable spelling in the tested 2x2 matrix reproduces the combination. Separately unresolved (2 surplus insns, pre-existing, NOT this lane): the tail guard `selected = 0; if (selected > sLastPlayerStart) selected = 0;` emits bge+li at @5d8 that target lacks, although target DOES emit the lwz+cmpwi - so the test was written but its body was folded away in the target and not in ours.
